presence of different costs / relating to storage / affect the management → presence-storage-management
disadvantages of direct investment / prefer to indirectly assume / to avoid problems → disadvantages-indirectly-avoid

involves a cost = entails (excludes/prevents/reduces are opposite or unrelated)
costs affect the management = influence (remove/delay/restore wrong)
disadvantages = drawbacks (merits is antonym; features/outcomes unrelated)
physical (실물의) antonym = mental; visible/natural/formal are other axes
presence (존재) antonym = absence; existence is synonym trap, abundance/influence other axes
(A) senior management position = 직위 ; (B) assume a position in commodity markets = 투자 포지션
a basic product used to produce other goods (oil/metals/agricultural) = commodity
typical(형용사) → typically(부사), modifies verb prefer
lack → lacking, 'that quality is lacking' (be lacking = ~이 부족하다)
storage, insurance, and cash ___ → opportunity costs (listed cost item)
disadvantages of ___ cause investors to prefer indirect position → direct investment
